summary: Hongli Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its amended and restated memorandum and articles of association became effective, following shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on June 5, 2026. The amendments include a dual-class share structure with 4.9 billion Class A and 100 million Class B ordinary shares, a share capital reduction and increase, all filed with the Cayman Islands Registrar. The Class A shares continue trading on Nasdaq under HLP. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation, with no transaction terms or strategic event.
